svg.text: V1.0.4 realistic blade section-loop lattice sandbox
Station-local section plane, not global XY projection and not hub/tip UV. x = chord/camber, y = local thickness/section-normal.
Main blade loop family: 6 main blades, review thickness 40 mm
Splitter blade loop family: 6 splitter blades, review thickness 32 mm
pressure side: loft pressure-face surface across eta stations
suction side: loft suction-face surface across eta stations
leading edge: loft rounded/G2 leading-edge surface
trailing edge: loft rounded/G2 trailing-edge surface
